description: Sydney and Nigel pursue relics ranging from Buddha's bowl and Casanova's book to royal crowns, Templar weapons and Egyptian artifacts, establishing a globe-trotting partnership in which the historical clue is usually only the beginning of the danger.

s01e01.description: Sydney and Nigel travel to Nepal to recover Buddha's legendary overflowing alms bowl for villagers building a shrine.

s01e02.description: A hunt through Chicago puts Sydney and Nigel on the trail of the gun once carried by Al Capone.

s01e03.description: After a plane crash, Sydney is drawn into a convent mystery involving the missing head of a nun decapitated centuries earlier.

s01e04.description: Sydney and Nigel head to California to recover the historic Bear Flag raised by the region's pioneers.

s01e05.description: The search for a lost Elvis Presley guitar takes Sydney and Nigel to Germany and into a distinctly modern relic hunt.

s01e06.description: Sydney, Nigel and rival hunter Kurt Reiner compete for a legendary baseball glove whose history has made it unexpectedly valuable.

s01e07.description: In the Peruvian jungle, Sydney and Nigel search for Paracelsus's lost scrolls and the formula said to turn lead into gold.

s01e08.description: A Norwegian king's runestone draws Sydney, Nigel and Stewie Harper to Stockholm, where history and competing interests complicate the recovery.

s01e09.description: Sydney and Nigel search Milan for Casanova's lost Book of Love, an artifact surrounded by romantic legend and modern danger.

s01e10.description: In Athens, Sydney, Nigel and Claudia enter the trail of the Minotaur's maze to find the legendary golden twine.

s01e11.description: A missing royal crown sends Sydney and Nigel to Dublin in search of the last King of Ireland's regalia.

s01e12.description: Sydney and Nigel brave Alaska while hunting the white-jade sarcophagus of a Chinese empress.

s01e13.description: Sydney and Nigel race rival relic hunter Avery Ko to recover a pharaoh's diamond before it is cut apart and sold.

s01e14.description: A supposedly cursed statue of the Egyptian cat goddess Mafdet disappears, and the deaths surrounding its theft make the legend hard to dismiss.

s01e15.description: Sydney and Nigel travel to Scotland to reunite the second of a pair of rings tied to the tragic love of Calum and Elena.

s01e16.description: A search in Atlantic City for Hungary's lost royal sceptre becomes more dangerous when the artifact's curse appears to have teeth.

s01e17.description: Sydney and Nigel travel through France to recover gemstones missing from Marie Antoinette's crown.

s01e18.description: The sword of Templar Grand Master Jacques de Molay sends Sydney and Nigel into a Parisian hunt shaped by the order's violent final days.

s01e19.description: Lost wedding vows could decide ownership of a French estate, sending Sydney and Nigel after a document that is both romantic relic and legal proof.

s01e20.description: In Brussels, Sydney and Nigel hunt the sacred Sundial of Zeus while a group calling themselves vampires raises the stakes.

s01e21.description: Stewie Harper rejoins Sydney and Nigel in France as they pursue the fabled Chalice of Truth.

s01e22.description: A stolen locket takes Sydney back to Paris, where recovering it may clear her late grandmother of an old accusation.
